[[File:Tea_leaf_plant.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Color/Legends|Blue]]-leaved plants in [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's laboratory]]]]
This '''blue-leaved plant''' was used by [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] in the resurrection of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. A number of them were kept potted in soil in a lab on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Blue Shadow">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the original script, this plant was supposed to be a "tea leaf plant," but a decision was made to have the plants be [[Color/Legends|blue]] to indicate their role in the manufacturing of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|virus]].<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode017.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Blue Shadow Virus}}</ref> It is unclear if the plants are native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Blue Shadow" />
